comments.value:
Thank you for your suggestion!

Some of this should be possible using VRChat's Udon scripting system. We're also working on letting users record video files in their worlds.

Please let us know if you'd like to update your suggestion, or if you have something to add in 2023 :)

details:
Hello~!
My suggestion would be something I think VRChat will greatly benefit in the future and from which it can spawn many new inspirations and ideas.

As you can see, many people use MMD models and on the ground of that I suggest enabling to make something like/similar to MMD Maps in which you can use scripts to enable visitors to use the cameras on that map and see a display on what it shows. Then you can add a record button and it can either directly store the compressed video it records onto your hard drive, or temporarily onto cloud from which they can download it. You can set it to automatically be deleted after the user exists the map.

The cameras most likely would need to be controlled by another VRChat user or have special VR controls that enable control over it like zoom in and out, placing way points in which it will travel from A to B, a timer in which it will activate too. Each Camera can record its own video which you can later combine in a video editing program and add music naturally for a more professional look too.

What it will be used for is for people to dance and record themselves doing it, effectively creating MMD like videos through VRChat. I think this new way of interacting in VRChat could be quite crucial for the future of it as it will open many other possibilities too and bring people even more closer than before.

I don't know if it's possible to create scripts and a system that allows users to do that and of course with protection as such worlds should have a limit or be friends invite only as to prevent abuse or other people blocking the view of the cameras if there are a few used for different perspectives.
But if it's possible it would really be a great feature to have for those creative people, which VRChat is full off.

Hope that you like my suggestion.
title: New way to use VRChat
